note: Consumed by the Skybase in-app update prompt (whatsNewFeed.ts). Entries NEWER than the installed update number are shown, so this must be regenerated every ship — a stale feed makes the prompt show nothing. Served at skybase.getlostadv.com/whatsnew.json.

updates.title: A tidier Career card
highlights: The Career stats card on your Logbook got a visual tidy-up — a clean two-column grid, a small icon on each stat, and faint dividers between rows
Purely cosmetic: same eight numbers, nothing added or removed — just easier on the eye

updates.title: Every flight says where you flew
highlights: Your logbook now names the site under each flight's date — worked out from where your track starts, matched against your own sites list
Nothing to fill in, and flights you recorded months ago get their names too
Career → Sites used to read 0 however many hills you'd flown; it counts properly now, and the Explorer / Wanderer / Globetrotter badges are finally earnable

updates.title: This list works again
highlights: The ‘what's new’ bullets in this pop-up had quietly stopped listing anything — fixed
Learn → Explain the metrics now covers Max climb

updates.title: Easier to find help
highlights: The Logbook's ‘Fix or recover a flight’ button now stands out with its own heading and colour — it was easy to scroll past

updates.title: Tidier Logbook
highlights: The repair tools (check for unsaved flights, recheck stats, recheck airtime) now sit behind one ‘Fix or recover a flight’ button
If Skybase actually finds a hidden or unsaved flight, it still tells you right on the Logbook

updates.title: Type the date when logging a flight by hand
highlights: The date field used to move one day at a time — now you just type day, month and year
It reads the full date back so you can check it before saving

updates.title: Clearer ‘nothing to recover’
highlights: The all-clear now names both things it checked: leftover track files, and flights hidden under an unfinished profile

updates.title: Missing flights found
highlights: Starting a flight in the first instant after opening Skybase could save it under a profile that hadn't finished loading — hiding it from your logbook
Open your Logbook: if any are affected you'll see ‘Restore hidden flights’, and one tap brings them back with their full track and stats
New flights can no longer end up in that state

updates.title: Give a friend their lost flight back
highlights: If another Skybase pilot was sharing near you, open that flight and use ‘Send <name> their track’ to build an .igc they can import
It's a coarser copy than their own recording — about one position every 8 seconds — so their distances read a little low

updates.title: Automatic trimming removed
highlights: Your flight clock now runs from the moment you tap Start, and your full track is always kept
Trimming the ground wait is still there where you can see it: ‘Trim flight time’ on a flight, or ‘Recheck airtime’ for the whole logbook

updates.title: Updating no longer closes the app
highlights: On some Android phones tapping ‘Update now’ could shut Skybase down instead of restarting it
Nothing was ever lost — the update was already saved and applied next time you opened it

updates.title: The update pop-up says which one it is
highlights: Skybase's own ‘Update available’ card now names itself, so it can't be confused with the App Store or Play Store's

updates.title: A no-fly day now says why
highlights: In the 5-day outlook, a day with no flyable hour used to show an empty box that looked like a broken app
Those days are now red and name what stopped them — Too windy, Gusty, Wrong wind, Low cloud, Rain or Storm

updates.title: Max climb, actually fixed
highlights: Climb is now read from your barometer — what a vario really measures — instead of GPS height, which jumps 10–15 m between readings

updates.title: Rating fixes
highlights: A gust is judged on how much the wind really surges, not the ratio alone — light breezes no longer turn good afternoons red
Cloud base no longer contradicts itself, and the wind chip can't read greener than the day it sits above

updates.title: Safer site ratings
highlights: A single serious hazard — rotor, wind off the back, over the site's limit, storms, cloud on the hill — can no longer be outvoted by good weather elsewhere
Expect fewer green hours. That's the fix, not a fault

updates.title: Accurate airtime for every flight
highlights: Ground time before launch and after landing was counted as flying, inflating each flight and your career total
Logbook → ‘Recheck airtime’ finds the real launch-to-landing window and shows you the change before applying it

updates.title: Recheck every flight's stats
highlights: Logbook → ‘Recheck flight stats’ re-measures every saved track so your list, career totals and achievements agree with your flights

updates.title: Shared flights report your real distances
highlights: Distance, straight line, XC and max climb in a shared link are now measured from your track instead of older saved figures

updates.title: Share a flight as a web link
highlights: Open a flight → ‘Share a web link’ and send friends a link they open in any browser — an animated replay of your track plus your stats, no app needed

updates.title: Stopping a flight always works now
highlights: If you ever tapped ‘end flight’ and the Stop/Cancel box didn't appear, Skybase now uses its own confirmation card that always shows

updates.title: Tester Pro unlock
highlights: Beta testers: enter your code in the paywall to unlock all of Pro, free

updates.title: Auto update checks
highlights: Skybase now checks for a new version when you open it and offers a one-tap update
This very screen — what's new, before you install

updates.title: Provable safety chain
highlights: See real proof your overdue auto-alert would reach a phone — delivery receipts, a contact reply-YES, and a Test-now self-test

updates.title: Branded Flight-saved card
highlights: A proper flight-summary card when you land, not a plain system pop-up

updates.title: Snappier flight start
highlights: Instant "Starting your flight…" feedback the moment you tap Start

updates.title: Lighter on memory & battery
highlights: Long-flight IGC logging and the 3D terrain map are easier on your phone

updates.title: 3D terrain flight replay
highlights: Watch your flight float at its true altitude over satellite 3D terrain, orbit it 360°
